The company is headquartered in [[Pune]] and has development centers in [[Europe]], [[USA]], [[Brazil]], [[Japan]] and [[China]], apart from India.{{cite web|url=https://www.kpit.com/contact/|title=Contact Us |publisher=KPIT Technologies|access-date=29 April 2019}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.kpit.com/news/kpit-quarterly-results-q3-fy-2019-20/|title=KPIT Q3FY20 Profit grows 19.3% sequentially|date=29 Jan 2020|publisher=KPIT Technologies|access-date=29 Jan 2020}} KPIT has filed 58 patents,{{cite web|url=http://www.computerworld.in/feature/kishor-patil-ceo-kpit-technologies|title=Kishor Patil, CEO of KPIT Technologies|website=ComputerWorld India|access-date=9 October 2017}} published some research papers, and has won several awards for innovation.{{cite web|url=https://www.kpit.com/about/|title=Awards and Recognition|publisher=KPIT Technologies|access-date=9 October 2017}}{{cite web|url=https://www.kpit.com/resources/downloads/investors/annual-reports/annual-report-2016-17.pdf|title=2016-1017 Annual Report {{!}} Technology Innovation at the Confluence of Engineering & Digital|publisher=KPIT Technologies|page=14|access-date=9 October 2017|archive-date=14 December 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181214070608/https://www.kpit.com/resources/downloads/investors/annual-reports/annual-report-2016-17.pdf|url-status=dead}} == History == KPIT was co-founded in 1990 by [[Ravi Pandit]] and Kishor Patil, as KPIT Infosystems. Both of them are [[chartered accountant]]s by profession, and they were partners in an accountancy firm, Kirtane & Pandit Chartered Accountants (KPCA).{{cite web|url=http://www.outlookbusiness.com/article_v3.aspx?artid%3D287922 |title=Sitting Pretty |work=Outlook Business |date=12 October 2013 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140714175738/http://www.outlookbusiness.com/article_v3.aspx?artid=287922 |archive-date=14 July 2014 }}{{cite web|url=https://knowledge.wharton.upenn.edu/article/as-the-auto-industry-shifts-gears-kpit-cummins-finds-room-for-growth/|title=As the Auto Industry Shifts Gears, KPIT Cummins Finds Room for Growth|work=Knowledge@Wharton|date=8 October 2009|access-date=21 March 2016}} The company made its [[Initial public offering|initial public offer]] (IPO) in 1999, which was 50 times oversubscribed.{{cite web|url=http://expressindia.indianexpress.com/fe/daily/19990223/fma23064.html|title=Investors log on to KPIT Systems, IPO oversubscribed 50 times|work=The Indian Express|date=23 February 1999|access-date=21 March 2016}}{{cite web|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/kpit-technologies-ltd/infocompanylisting/companyid-4471.cms|title=KPIT Technologies Listing Information|website=The Economic Times|access-date=8 January 2019}} In 2002, Cummins Infotech, the IT department of [[Cummins]] merged with KPIT, and the name of the company became KPIT Cummins Infosystems Ltd.{{cite web|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/cummins-infotech-merges-with-kpit-infosys/articleshow/9192349.cms |title=Cummins Infotech merges with KPIT Infosys|work=The Economic Times |date=8 May 2002 |access-date=21 March 2016}} KPIT Cummins Infosystems changed its name to "KPIT Technologies Limited" in September 2013. This was in line with Cummins' decision to reduce its shareholding in KPIT, to focus on its core business of engine and generator manufacturing.{{cite web|url=http://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/kpit-adopts-new-brandvisual-identity_947070.html|title=KPIT adopts new brand & visual identity|date=10 September 2013|publisher=Moneycontrol.com|access-date=21 March 2016}} In January 2018, [[Birlasoft]], an IT company, and KPIT announced their merger, with plans to immediately split into two new companies. {{cite web|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/ites/kpit-birlasoft-to-merge-and-split-into-two-publicly-traded-companies/articleshow/62705366.cms |title=KPIT Technologies: KPIT, Birlasoft to merge and split into two publicly-traded companies |work=The Economic Times |date=30 January 2018 |access-date=16 May 2019}} In April 2018, this deal was approved by the [[Competition Commission of India]].{{cite web|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/cci-approves-kpit-birlasoft-deal-2545651.html|title=CCI approves KPIT-Birlasoft deal|date=9 April 2018 |publisher=Moneycontrol.com|access-date=8 January 2019}} Following the [[corporate spin-off]], one company focused on IT and the other on automotive was formed. The IT company operated under the name Birlasoft, and the automotive company operated under the name KPIT Technologies. According to the original plan, the shareholders of Birlasoft received 22 shares of the combined company for every 9 shares they held in Birlasoft, while the shareholders of KPIT Technologies received 1 share of the new KPIT Technologies company for every share they held in KPIT Technologies. In an interview, [[Ravi Pandit]], co-founder, chairman, and CEO of KPIT Technologies, commented upon this deal, "Segregating business IT and automotive tech businesses will provide sharper focus on each business."{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/expert-view/why-kpit-and-birlasoft-are-merging-to-create-2-separate-companies/articleshow/62704887.cms|title=Why KPIT and Birlasoft are merging to create 2 separate companies|date=30 January 2018|work=The Economic Times|access-date=8 January 2019}} On 22 April 2019, KPIT Technologies Limited got listed on BSE and NSE. The transaction resulted in two publicly traded specialized technology companies – KPIT Technologies and Birlasoft.{{Cite news|url=https://auto.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/auto-technology/kpit-technologies-gets-listed-on-bse-and-nse/68991090|title=KPIT Technologies gets listed on BSE and NSE|date=22 April 2019|work=Economic Times|access-date=29 June 2019}} On 6 June 2019, KPIT launched its new corporate logo.{{cite news|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/kpit-unveils-its-new-visual-brand-identity-119060600233_1|title=KPIT unveils its New Visual Brand Identity|date=6 June 2019|work=Business Standard|access-date=9 June 2019}}{{cite news |publisher=Moneycontrol.com |title=KPIT Technologies shares gain 5% as Goldman Sachs retains 'buy' after acquisition |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/stocks/kpit-technologies-shares-gain-5-as-goldman-sachs-retains-buy-after-acquisition-9213901.html}} ==References== {{Reflist}} {{authority control}} [[Category:International information technology consulting firms]] [[Category:Software companies of India]] [[Category:Engineering companies of India]] [[Category:Multinational companies headquartered in India]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1990]] [[Category:Technology companies established in 1990]] [[Category:Companies based in Pune]] [[Category:1990 establishments in Maharashtra]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]
extract:
KPIT Technologies Ltd is an Indian multinational corporation which provides engineering research and development (ER&D) services to automotive companies. The company is headquartered in Pune and has development centers in Europe, USA, Brazil, Japan and China, apart from India.
KPIT has filed 58 patents, published some research papers, and has won several awards for innovation.
